beats.care: AI fakes now look real. Forwarding one spreads lies about real people, so check before you share.
beats.what: An X account posted an AI-made image claiming Police Commissioner VC Sajjanar had arrested someone over a fake Jr NTR video. He called it out as fake.
beats.why: A vulgar AI-morphed video of Jr NTR and Janhvi Kapoor went viral last week. A fake 'arrest' pic followed.

cards.body: Sajjanar reshared the post, said the image was AI-generated, and warned people not to fall for or forward deepfakes without checking. He tagged Hyderabad Police and the cybercrime police.
The account deleted the post and apologised to Sajjanar right in his comments.

a.body: Some fans are misusing his image; people must verify before sharing anything.
a.label: Sajjanar says

b.body: The people spreading it aren't real fans, and one account shouldn't be blamed on all of them.
b.label: Some fans say

opts: An AI-made fake image or video of a real person
cards.why: Deepfakes use AI to make real people appear to say or do things they never did.

cards.q: Ever forwarded something that turned out to be fake?
